verdict.rationale: Foreloop lets agents run locally in a checkout and claim/report tasks, and humans can approve contracts or view agent status via a dashboard row per worker, but there's no evidence of a live handoff mechanism to pause, take over, or redirect an in-progress task from editor/terminal/browser mid-execution. missing for 10: explicit takeover/interrupt UX, editor-integrated control of a running agent, terminal command to seize an active task, and any hands-on confirmation of mid-task redirection.
